# /vg/ League 25

Squad of 23. A player's rating is his best of: dribbling, goalkeeping, finishing, low pass, lofted pass, heading, swerve, catching, clearing, reflexes, coverage, body control, physical contact, kicking power, explosive power, ball control, ball winning, jump, place kicking, stamina, speed, aggression.
May sit below their target: attacking prowess, defensive prowess, weak foot usage, weak foot accuracy.

## Tiers
- **Gold**: 2 per team; every stat 99; form 8, injury resistance 2, weak foot 4/4; 5 paid cards, 1 free COM style, 12 free tricks; 2 A positions.
- **Silver**: 3 per team; every stat 88; form 8, injury resistance 2, weak foot 4/4; 4 paid cards, 1 free COM style, 12 free tricks; 2 A positions.
- **Regular**: the rest of the squad; every stat 77; form 4, injury resistance 1, weak foot 2/2; 3 paid cards, 12 free tricks; 2 A positions.

## Heights
Brackets: Manlet up to 175, Mid 180, Tall 185, Giant 190, Colossal 210 cm.
- **Purple** : 6 manlet, 6 mid, 5 tall, 6 giant, 0 colossal.

## Every team
Every player is rated A at his registered position; no B ratings; B ratings count as A positions; GK is never a second A; age 15 to 50; weight between height − 129 (at least 30) and height − 81; at most 41 skill cards.

## Card groups
- **Tricks**: scissors feint, flip flap, marseille turn, sombrero, cut behind and turn, scotch move, rabona, malicia, double touch, crossover turn, step on skill, no look pass.

## Special rules
- **Acrobatic Finishing is a free card**: Acrobatic Finishing free.
- **The captain's Captaincy card and one more are free**: The captain: +1 paid card, Captaincy free.
- **Medals cannot be goalkeepers**: Gold or Silver, registered GK: not allowed ("Medals cannot play as GK").
- **Goalkeepers at 189 count as tall**: Registered GK, 189 cm: count 4 cm shorter.
- **Tall goalkeepers are 189**: Registered GK, 181 to 188 cm: not allowed ("GKs in this bracket must be 189cm").
- **Medals cannot be giants**: Gold or Silver, 190 cm: not allowed ("Medals cannot be 190cm").
- **Goalkeepers cannot be giants**: Registered GK, 190 cm: not allowed ("GKs cannot be 190cm").
- **Manlets**: Manlets: +1 paid card, +1 A position, weak foot up to 4/4.
- **Manlet bonus**: Manlets: may get +2 for Gold, +2 for Silver, +5 for Regular to every stat.
